# External dependencies of FuguOracle. scripts/fugubench deps installs
# each line.

# The runtime dist entry takes the signify tier, and the deps verb
# needs signify(1) to check that signature. The tool environment
# installs before every other one, so the command is there when the
# runtime chain reaches the entry.
tool pkg signify-openbsd

# The secret gate of make check runs gitleaks, so the tool environment
# installs it before every other environment.
tool bin gitleaks https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_{os}_{arch}.tar.gz gitleaks

# The interop harness of TEST-INTEROP drives fuguvm with Fugu::Process
# (TEST-INTEROP-4), so the host needs the dist at run time. The
# harness runs on the host only, and no port takes it.
runtime dist https://github.com/FuguBSD/Fugu/releases/latest/download/Fugu.tar.gz
